items.title: C.J. Stroud: Keeps piling up TDs in win
items.text:
Stroud completed 21 of 26 passes for 194 yards with three touchdowns and one interception and rushed six times for 27 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.title: Jonathan Taylor: Minimal production with 15 touches
items.text:
Taylor rushed 11 times for 21 yards and brought in four of five targets for six yards in the Colts' 26-3 loss to the Texans on Thursday.

items.title: Nico Collins: Gets into end zone Thursday
items.text:
Collins secured three of five targets for 58 yards and a touchdown in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.title: David Montgomery: Season-best effort in win
items.text:
Montgomery rushed 26 times for 107 yards and brought in three of four targets for 17 yards in the Texans' 26-3 win over the Colts on Thursday.

items.title: Seth McGowan: Won't return to Thursday Night Football
items.text:
McGowan (hamstring) has been ruled out for the rest of Thursday's game against the Texans, Jane Slater of NFL Network reports.
